title: Budgeted Quotient-Residual Guidance for Frozen Pocket-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.31222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pocket-conditioned molecular diffusion updates ambient atom coordinates, but many lead-optimization objectives are expressed on quotient features such as distances, contacts, and anchored substructures. We introduce budgeted quotient-residual guidance (QRG), an inference-time correction that makes these quotient objectives active without retraining the molecular generator. QRG lifts quotient covectors to metric-horizontal ambient directions and delivers them through a trust budget set by the frozen sampler's own step norm: quotient geometry chooses the direction, while sampler motion bounds the scale. We derive the horizontal lift, closed-form sampler-budget update, KL/kinetic interpretation around a frozen reverse step, equivariance conditions, and a product-budget split for budget-capped section and residual controls. translated_title: 面向冻结口袋条件分子扩散的预算化商残差引导
translated_abstract: 口袋条件分子扩散更新的是环境原子坐标，但许多先导化合物优化目标却表达在商特征（如距离、接触和锚定子结构）上。我们提出预算化商残差引导（QRG），这是一种推理时校正方法，无需重新训练分子生成器即可激活这些商目标。QRG 将商余向量提升为度量水平的（metric-horizontal）环境方向，并通过由冻结采样器自身步长范数设定的信任预算来传递：商几何决定方向，采样器运动约束尺度。我们推导了水平提升、闭式采样器预算更新、冻结反向步骤附近的 KL/动力学解释、等变性条件，以及用于预算受限的截面与残差控制的乘积预算拆分。受控商任务证实，相对采样器的传递方式能够激活原始局部商梯度所难以激活的信号……
tldr: 提出推理时的预算化商残差引导（QRG），无需重训冻结的口袋条件分子扩散模型，即可借助商几何定向并以采样器自身步长作为信任预算，激活距离、接触等商空间优化目标。
en_tdlr: We propose budgeted quotient-residual guidance (QRG), an inference-time correction that activates quotient objectives (distances, contacts, anchored substructures) on frozen pocket-conditioned molecular diffusion by horizontally lifting quotient covectors and bounding corrections with the sampler's own step-norm trust budget.
